name: Copperstone Resources AB Series B
summary: Based in Sweden, Copperstone Resources AB engages in the exploration of both base and precious metals. The company primarily seeks out copper, zinc, gold, lead, and silver, but also extends its exploration activities to manganese, tungsten, cobalt, vanadium, and iron ores. Its operational assets include exploitation concessions and exploration permits. Incorporated in 2006, the company, formerly known as Kopparberg Mineral AB (publ), officially became Copperstone Resources AB (publ) in February 2015, and maintains its headquarters in Kiruna.
